purpose: Select a less device-identifying network-history representation using benign development-device histories only, after V36 confirmed strong cross-device domain fingerprinting.

source.reuse: exact V35 canonical rows and history summaries

candidate_views.v35_full: all seven V35 history-operation blocks over all 33 canonical channels
candidate_views.derivative_channels: delta/recent2/recent4 blocks over all canonical channels
candidate_views.anonymous_dynamics: std/delta/recent2/recent4 pooled across count and fraction channel groups using anonymous distribution summaries
candidate_views.anonymous_derivatives: delta/recent2/recent4 pooled across count and fraction channel groups using anonymous distribution summaries
candidate_views.anonymous_fraction_derivatives: delta/recent2/recent4 pooled across fraction channels only using anonymous distribution summaries

domain_cv.metric: mean benign heldout-vs-other-device logistic domain ROC-AUC
domain_cv.selection_rule: choose lowest mean ROC-AUC; if views are within 0.01 AUC choose the lower-dimensional view
domain_cv.target: ROC-AUC <= 0.70 is preferred but not required for audit completion

claim_boundary: V37 is representation diagnosis/selection only. It produces no attack forecasting accuracy claim.
final_validation: locked; external/new final validation remains required after any representation changes
